task:
A store buys 14 units at 9300 credits each and 30 units at 9309 credits each. It returns 9 units from the FIRST batch at their original unit cost. What is the exact weighted average cost of the remaining units? After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 7% surcharge, then subtract 21 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 11% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 18 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 14% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.

Adjustment 8: apply a 4% surcharge, then subtract 26 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 26 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 27 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 16%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 6% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 12 credits, then discount the whole amount by 7%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 9 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 15 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 3% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
